prompt: LLVM constrained frem rounding mode argument effect
answer:
The rounding-mode argument to `llvm.experimental.constrained.frem` has no effect: `frem`’s result is never rounded. It is included only for consistency with the other constrained floating-point intrinsics.

The constrained `frem` operation still uses its exception-behavior argument. Its result is the floating-point remainder, with the same sign as the dividend.
